Replace the worn foot pedal with the FC-9 hand-operated speed-controller variant, as recommended by the repair technician and required for Rosa's accessibility.
Ensure the adjustable sewing table in Maya's craft room can be set to 72 cm height for Rosa's seated use.
Jordan's three cotton garments must be ready by September 1, 2026; schedule machine time accordingly after servicing and pedal replacement are complete.
Rosa will use the FC-9 hand-operated speed-controller variant and requires a 72 cm seated work surface height.
Leah's mending and alterations will be scheduled alongside Jordan's and Rosa's projects once the machine is serviced and the FC-9 is installed.
